goal: Migrate DAL source compatibility to DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 without changing installed profiles, credentials, approvals or historical evidence.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Runtime dependencies, native host and tool-plugin peers align with the requested DSH and Cordis release set.
Async sandbox confinement and native session-event consumers preserve fail-closed behavior and privacy-safe provenance.
Compatibility deltas, conservative recording limits and historical evidence boundaries are documented.
Focused checks, the repository gate and clean-consumer packaging checks pass without a live model call.

outcome.summary: Local source migration and packaging verification passed. Deployment and publication remain separate human actions.

what_worked: Exact prerelease alignment exposed API drift through real service types.
Synthetic native session envelopes verified nested tool-result correlation and digest-only prompt recording.
The repository gate and clean-consumer smoke passed while retaining approval and quarantine boundaries.
what_failed: Initial compilation exposed asynchronous confinement and a relocated JSON-value type.
Rejected-promise mocking was unsuitable for the sandbox regression fixture; explicit synthetic async providers verified the adapter instead.

calls.name: vitest
calls.purpose: Verify native event and sandbox adapter compatibility with synthetic inputs.

calls.name: pnpm-check
calls.purpose: Run the repository type, build, test, capsule, policy and deterministic evaluation gates.

calls.name: release-smoke
calls.purpose: Verify changed tarballs in a disposable consumer without profile installation or model execution.

evidence.summary: Native session constructors, nested call identity, failure flags, prompt invalidation and manifest alignment pass; asynchronous sandbox adapter tests also pass.
Repository gate passes with 1256 tests passed and seven opt-in tests skipped; capsule, guardrail and deterministic benchmark checks pass.
Eight local release artifacts pass clean-consumer CLI, schema, template, plugin-import and offline replay verification; nothing is published or mounted into a DSH profile.
Documents the current compatibility release, API changes, conservative prompt provenance limits and unchanged historical evidence identities.

uncertainty.statement: Local tests do not establish live OAuth, provider, launcher/profile or OS sandbox integration.
uncertainty.resolution: Perform separately approved integration verification before deployment or live use.

uncertainty.statement: Changed DAL packages retain their existing version and have not been published.
uncertainty.resolution: Choose a new coordinated DAL release version and obtain separate publication approval before publishing.

notes: Source migration awaits maintainer review. Worktree authorization does not authorize deployment, credential use, live calls or publication.
